title: I Traced The Robocalls. The FTC Did The Rest.
script: My car's extended warranty had already expired for two years, which didn't stop the same recorded voice from calling four times a day claiming it was about to lapse. I work fraud analysis for a telecom carrier, so instead of hanging up I let the call route through, then pulled the originating trunk numbers from our own network logs during my lunch break. The calls all traced back to one leased call center running under six different fake business names, all sharing a single billing address in a strip mall three states away. I packaged the routing data, the recordings, and the shared address into one report and handed it to our compliance team, who forwarded it straight to the FTC the same afternoon. Eight weeks later the center's phone lines were disconnected mid-shift, the operators mid-call when it happened, and the company behind it is now facing a multimillion-dollar settlement it will never fully pay off.
